description: Least-privilege capability for the app's windows — the main one and the windows a tab was moved out to (win-N, created only by the backend; the WebView has no permission to create windows): app events (listen/unlisten/emit), the app's name and versions for Help, the window controls the custom (frameless) title bar drives on Windows/Linux (drag, resize, minimize/maximize/close), file open/save dialogs, and opening external https links only (no path/reveal, no message/ask/confirm dialogs).
